{{Top|leg}}
A '''demo pack''' was a type of [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charge]]. They were used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]] from the [[Destabilization]] branch of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Calamari Project|infiltration]] mission on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Demo packs were used to rig a tunnel to explode in the [[Morjanssik Mine]].
